newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Notionnel capped at 129.44, to drift down.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Notionnel capped at 129.44, to drift down.

text.p: June notionnel futures on MATIF will get no further than mid-March highs around 129.44 on Thursday and will likely pull back before launching higher again, technical analysts said.
"It's certainly bullish in the big picture," David Sneddon, technical analyst at Credit Suisse First Boston in London, said. "It's just how much of a pull back we see before it goes up."
Sneddon expected the market to stall around the March 17 and March 14 highs of 129.44 and 129.40 respectively.
Notionnel futures were quoted at 129.24 at 0800 GMT, up 22 basis points from Wednesday's session.

Sneddon said there was many layers of support to catch the notionnel with the frist one coming in at the 128.80,90 area. Support at 128.80 comes from the spike high on April 9 while 128.90 was the low on April 16.
Under there, trendline support comes in around 128.60, he said.
Susan Rigg, technical analyst at Chart Analysis in London, also noted support at the 128.80 high and said a close below there was required to negate the upmove.
Beyond this session's initial resistance around 129.44, Sneddon saw a target of 129.66 from lows in the middle of March.
The main ojective however, was 129.80, near the 61.8 percent retracement of the February to April decline.
"That's the next major target," Sneddon said.
June Pibor futures were quoted at 96.67 at 0814 GMT, down one basis point from Wednesday.
